notes:
Auto Align for bass and guitars (DI and after the amp): new roles Bass DI, Bass Amp, Guitar DI, Guitar Amp. Put them in their own group; the plugin aligns the whole sound, not hits.
Follow: keeps the phase while the DAW plays (small steps, never far from where you set it).
Bypass for the whole group in one click.
A warning in the bottom line when drums and bass/guitar share one group.
Activation data: for a DAW the plugin does not recognise, the file name of that program (only the name, no folder) is sent with the trial or activation request instead of just "Unknown".
